text: かえって　きて　おったのか　ポケモンずかんは　どのくらい　あつまったのか　みせて　くれんか？

structure.jp: かえって　きて　おったのか
ポケモンずかんは　どのくらい　あつまったのか
structure.en: how much the Pokédex has filled up

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.span: かえって　きて　おった
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows the state after something happened; おった is the old-man way of saying いた. かえって　きて　おった = 'you had come back'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれないか
patterns.explanation: てくれないか asks someone to do something for you, like 'won't you'; くれん is the old-man short form of くれない. みせて　くれんか = 'won't you show me?'.

patterns.name: 〜のか
patterns.span: かえって　きて　おったのか
patterns.explanation: のか at the end shows you have just noticed something and are half asking about it. かえって　きて　おったのか = 'oh, so you've come back?'.
